description:
## What

In `src/fetcher/dns_cache.cr`, replace `@@max_entries : Int32 = 10_000` with a named `DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES = 10_000` constant. Use the constant in the type annotation.

## Why

Catseye flagged the literal `10000` as a MagicNumber. A named constant documents intent and makes future tuning explicit. Tiny style improvement.

## How

```crystal
DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES = 10_000
@@max_entries : Int32 = DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES
```

## Done when

- `DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES` constant defined on `Fetcher::DnsCache`
- `@@max_entries` uses it
- Catseye MagicNumber finding goes away on dns_cache.cr
- Full spec suite still green (415 examples)
title: Refactor: extract DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES constant in DnsCache
